digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 21 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：TypeScript, Rust, Python）和 14 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「Agent 技能与工具」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: morluto/rea
repos.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
repos.summary_zh: 用 AI Agent 逆向分析任意软件，从应用行为一路深挖到原生二进制

repos.name: anomalyco/opencode
repos.description: The open source coding agent.
repos.summary_zh: 开源 TypeScript 编码智能体，让开发者用自然语言直接驱动代码生成与修改

repos.name: stablyai/orca
repos.description: Orca is the place for working with a fleet of agents (e.g. Grok Bot, Claude Code). Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on deskt
repos.summary_zh: 用自有订阅跨桌面、移动和远程运行 Claude Code 等编码 Agent 集群的统一工作台

repos.name: ruvnet/ruflo
repos.description: 🌊 The original agent harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features a
repos.summary_zh: 原始多智能体编排框架，支持自适应记忆与自学习智能，可部署协作式AI工作流

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.name: xerj-org/xerj
repos.description: Local-first search engine and MCP server for AI agents. One Rust binary indexes code, docs, logs, JSONL/CSV and PDFs for BM25 full-text, vector and hy
repos.summary_zh: 单二进制本地优先搜索引擎与 MCP 服务器，为 AI Agent 统一索引代码文档日志并支持 BM25 全文、向量与混合检索

repos.name: ModernRelay/omnigraph
repos.description: Object-storage native graph database with branching and typed ontology
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 打造的对象存储原生图数据库，支持分支与类型化本体，让图数据像代码一样版本化管理

repos.name: kividbio/kividb
repos.description: A fast, multi-threaded Redis® and Valkey alternative written in Rust: drop-in compatible, with full-text and vector search built in
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 打造的多线程 Redis/Valkey 替代品，可直接替换并内置全文与向量搜索

repos.name: cdcailf/cjkfold
repos.description: Fold look-alike CJK glyphs (Kangxi radicals, CJK radical supplements) so text extracted from PDFs matches again.
repos.summary_zh: 专治PDF提取中康熙部首等CJK形近字不匹配问题，用NFKC折叠让文本检索重新对齐

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.name: vllm-project/vllm
repos.description: A high-throughput and memory-efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs
repos.summary_zh: 高吞吐内存高效的大模型推理与服务引擎，用PagedAttention解决显存瓶颈大幅提升吞吐

repos.name: tashfeenahmed/freellmapi
repos.description: 7.4 billion tokens per month. 34 free LLM providers. 635 free model endpoints. All behind one /v1 endpoint, plus any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint
repos.summary_zh: 聚合34家免费LLM供应商共635个模型端点于单一/v1接口，支持智能路由、自动故障转移与密钥加密

repos.name: sgl-project/sglang
repos.description: SGLang is a high-performance serving framework for large language models and multimodal models.
repos.summary_zh: 高性能大模型与多模态模型推理服务框架，主打极致吞吐与低延迟调度

repos.name: trymirai/uzu
repos.description: A high-performance inference engine for AI models
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 打造的高性能 AI 模型推理引擎，主打极致速度与低资源占用

categories.name: 🔬 模型训练与微调
categories.desc: 预训练、微调、对齐、评估等模型构建环节

repos.name: Folkbench/folkbench
repos.description: AI API 中转站评测排行与切换工具：实测可用率、延迟与价格 · Open-source AI API relay benchmark, rankings & switcher for Claude Code / Codex
repos.summary_zh: 实测各家 AI API 中转站的可用率延迟与价格并一键切换，帮 Claude Code 和 Codex 用户避开不稳定线路

categories.name: 🎨 应用与前端
categories.desc: 面向终端用户的 AI 应用、UI 组件、聊天界面

repos.name: Comfy-Org/ComfyUI
repos.description: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface. The fastest local inference engine in the world.
repos.summary_zh: 最强大的模块化扩散模型图形节点界面，全球最快本地推理引擎，让AI绘图工作流自由搭建

repos.name: luongnv89/claude-howto
repos.description: A visual, example-driven guide to Claude Code — from basic concepts to advanced agents, with copy-paste templates that bring immediate value.
repos.summary_zh: 用可视化示例和即拷即用模板带你从零掌握 Claude Code 基础概念到高级 Agent 开发的实战指南

repos.name: thesysdev/openui
repos.description: The Open Standard for Generative UI
repos.summary_zh: 让大模型直接输出可交互 UI 的开放标准，用 TypeScript 定义生成式界面组件规范

repos.name: claration/impactor
repos.description: Cross-platform & feature rich iOS/iPadOS/tvOS sideloading application. Formerly known as PlumeImpactor.
repos.summary_zh: 跨平台功能丰富的 iOS/iPadOS/tvOS 侧载工具，用 Rust 重写后性能更强，替代已停更的 Cydia Impactor 解决应用签名安装难题

categories.name: 📦 其他热门
categories.desc: 值得关注的其他 AI/ML 开源项目

repos.name: yt-dlp/yt-dlp
repos.description: A feature-rich command-line audio/video downloader
repos.summary_zh: 功能最全的命令行音视频下载器，支持数千网站并持续活跃更新

repos.name: iptv-org/iptv
repos.description: Collection of publicly available IPTV channels from all over the world
repos.summary_zh: 汇集全球公开可用的 IPTV 频道源并自动校验更新，一站式解决找直播源难、失效快的问题

repos.name: fastapi/fastapi
repos.description: FastAPI framework, high performance, easy to learn, fast to code, ready for production
repos.summary_zh: 高性能Python Web框架，自动生成API文档，类型提示驱动开发，开箱即用适合生产部署

repos.name: oven-sh/bun
repos.description: Incredibly fast JavaScript runtime, bundler, test runner, and package manager – all in one
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 打造的超快 JavaScript 运行时，集打包、测试、包管理于一体，一站式替代 Node.js 工具链

papers.title: Direct Pass@$k$ Optimization for Thought Pruning: Balancing Quality and Diversity in Test-Time Reasoning
papers.abstract: Test-time scaling has emerged as a key inference strategy for reasoning models, where a model generates a large number of candidate solutions in the hope of finding at least one correct solution. Runn
papers.summary_zh: 提出直接Pass@k优化框架用于思维剪枝，在测试时推理中兼顾候选解质量与多样性，有效降低计算开销

papers.title: Low-Bit N-Gram Embeddings for Language Models
papers.abstract: Many recent open-weight language models use n-gram embedding tables to improve performance. These tables store learned representations of short token sequences, such as pairs or triples of consecutive
papers.summary_zh: 提出低比特n-gram嵌入表压缩方法，大幅降低语言模型内存占用且保持性能

papers.title: Causal Chain of Thought: Mitigating Attention Leakage via Context Isolation
papers.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting elicits step-by-step rationales that appear to explain model predictions, but there is no guarantee these steps causally drive the final answer. In standard autoregres
papers.summary_zh: 提出因果思维链方法，通过上下文隔离阻断注意力泄漏，确保推理步骤真正驱动最终答案

papers.title: Can an Agent Debug a Web Corpus? Agentic Auditing of Slovak FineWeb2
papers.abstract: Multilingual pipelines such as FineWeb2 apply one recipe across a thousand languages, leaving the failure modes of individual languages unanticipated. We use an LLM once, as a corpus debugger rather t
papers.summary_zh: 提出用工具型LLM智能体以只读预算API审计斯洛伐克语FineWeb2语料，替代分类器定位单语失败模式

papers.title: How Ground Truth Shapes Retrieval Scores: Evidence-Aware Evaluation of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation System for Breast Lesions
papers.abstract: Purpose: To describe an evidence-aware retrieval evaluation protocol for a clinical retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system over breast lesion management literature, addressing the dependence of r
papers.summary_zh: 提出证据感知检索评估协议，揭示检索分数依赖标注覆盖度，并在18文档18查询乳腺病变语料上验证其必要性

papers.title: Reliable AI-Assisted Decisions via Selective Auditing
papers.abstract: We consider online monitoring of an AI system that produces a sequence of decisions. At each round, the system outputs a proposed decision together with a confidence score estimating the trustworthine
papers.summary_zh: 提出选择性审计框架在线监控AI决策，利用置信度分数决定是否人工复核，在保证可靠性同时显著降低审计成本

papers.title: METTA: Memory-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation for Meta-Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Meta-reinforcement learning aims to train agents that adapt quickly to unseen tasks from limited interaction, but this requires representing task evidence over long interaction histories. Classical re
papers.summary_zh: 提出记忆增强的元强化学习测试时适应方法METTA，通过检索长交互历史中的任务证据提升快速适应能力

papers.title: EpiSEM-Bench: Evaluating Safety and Evidence Recovery in LLM Agents under Missing Evidence
papers.abstract: Tool-using language model agents rely on environmental facts to decide whether an action is permitted. When a tool response omits a safety-relevant fact, an agent may carry out a prohibited action eve
papers.summary_zh: 提出EpiSEM-Bench基准评测工具型LLM代理在证据缺失下的安全与证据恢复能力，揭示代理在工具响应遗漏安全事实时仍执行违规操作的风险

papers.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
papers.abstract: Robotic foundation models are typically evaluated through costly closed-loop rollouts, which motivates cheap offline proxies for model capability. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests
papers.summary_zh: 提出基于柏拉图表示假设的传感器运动对齐离线代理指标，无需闭环部署即可低成本评估具身策略能力

papers.title: SpectralCanary: Embarrassingly Simple Low-Frequency Traces for T2I Dataset-Use Auditing
papers.abstract: Auditing whether a text-to-image (T2I) model was fine-tuned on a particular image collection is difficult: a model can absorb collection-level visual characteristics without reproducing training image
papers.summary_zh: 提出利用低频频谱痕迹的极简T2I数据集使用审计方法，无需修改模型即可检测微调数据来源

papers.title: Diffusion Language Models for Perplexity-Aware Black-Box Attacks
papers.abstract: \emph{Continuous-space} attacks find prompts that trigger malicious behaviors, such as overthinking, in black-box LLMs by sampling or optimizing over a low-dimensional Gaussian latent space and decodi
papers.summary_zh: 提出面向扩散语言模型的困惑度感知黑盒攻击方法，利用扩散解码替代随机映射实现连续空间提示优化，显著提升攻击成功率

papers.title: Phase Transition from Random Features to Fully Trainable Networks
papers.abstract: Constructing accurate and computationally tractable approximation spaces is a fundamental task in scientific computing. Partially trainable neural networks bridge fixed random features and fully adapt
papers.summary_zh: 揭示部分可训练网络中随机特征到全可训练网络的相变规律并量化近似界

papers.title: Cost-Aware Abstention for LLM-Based IT Ticket Classification
papers.abstract: Wrong automatic routing of an IT support ticket can cost more than human triage. We evaluate cost-aware abstention as an offline, cost-conditional readiness assessment: select a routing policy on cali
papers.summary_zh: 提出成本感知弃权框架用于IT工单分类，在标定数据上按显式成本选策略并在测试集冻结评估，实现离线成本条件就绪度评估

papers.title: A Fix for Softmax and Cross-Entropy
papers.abstract: Standard implementations of softmax, log-softmax, and cross-entropy have two numerical bugs. The first bug, Softmax Collapse, rounds the target logit's gradient to zero if that one logit is much large
papers.summary_zh: 指出标准softmax与交叉熵存在梯度归零和抵消两个数值缺陷并提出修复方案使梯度正确求和为零
